cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Raise the Impossibility
cards.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. For my restaurant, your flying chair needs a flying table. Dinner should travel with the diner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can make the whole table circle the room.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Add a hovering waiter. Nobody should chase their soup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter can serve while flying upside down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then commission gravity-proof soup. I won't make customers rotate between courses.

mechanism: A grades its pupil flying furniture as promising but incomplete and demands more impossible service arrangements justified by diner comfort.
confusable: Not merely agreeing to wonders: every offer is answered with a greater practical commitment that A asks the pupil to fulfil.
comparison: Restaurant design pupil pushed toward service invention versus event planner pushed toward inclusive hospitality.
